title: No distinction based on marital status.
bodyText: Except as otherwise provided in sections 560:2-114, 560:2-125, 560:2-126, or 560:2-127, a parent-child relationship shall be deemed to exist between a child and the child's genetic parents, regardless of the parents' marital status.
bodyHtml: [§560:2-123]  No distinction based on marital status.  Except as otherwise provided in sections 560:2-114, 560:2-125, 560:2-126, or 560:2-127, a parent-child relationship shall be deemed to exist between a child and the child's genetic parents, regardless of the parents' marital status. [L 2023, c 158, pt of §2]
